_comment: Edit freely. 'fields' are extracted per call type; 'compliance' checks only run for regulated types. Field names are keys in the output, so keep them stable once you have data.

qualification.need: why the customer wants this / the problem or trigger
qualification.budget: what they can or will spend, or how they plan to pay
qualification.authority: who decides, who else must approve
qualification.timeline: when they want to decide or have it in place

compliance_checks.recording_notice: told the call is recorded / consent to record
compliance_checks.identity_and_purpose: agent stated who they are, the company and the purpose of the call
compliance_checks.terms_or_risks_explained: key terms, charges, risks or conditions were explained
compliance_checks.exclusions_or_fees_explained: exclusions, limitations, fees or penalties were explained
compliance_checks.no_pressure_selling: no undue pressure, false urgency or misleading claims (yes = no pressure was used)
compliance_checks.time_to_consider_given: customer was given time to think or compare, or offered a cooling-off period
compliance_checks.recommendation_matches_needs: what was recommended fits the needs the customer stated
compliance_checks.consent_or_optout_handled: customer consent / opt-out or do-not-contact requests were respected

saas.label: Software / SaaS / B2B
saas.describe: software, platform, subscription, licence or other B2B product

fields.implementation_fee: one-off setup or onboarding fee, if any
fields.free_trial_or_pilot: true if a trial or pilot was offered or run
fields.decision_criteria: what they will judge options on
fields.critical_event: deadline or event driving the purchase

insurance.label: Insurance
insurance.describe: life, health, motor, home, travel or other insurance policy

fields.who_is_covered: people or assets to be covered
fields.dependents: number and details of dependents, incl. special needs
fields.coverage_gap: gap between need and existing cover, if discussed
fields.health_or_medical_disclosures: pre-existing conditions or lifestyle factors mentioned

vehicle.label: Vehicles
vehicle.describe: new or used car, bike or other vehicle

fields.emi_and_tenure: monthly instalment and months, if financed
fields.financing_discussed: true if loan or finance came up
fields.credit_application_started: true if a finance application was started
fields.appointment: showroom visit or test drive appointment date/time, if set

real_estate.label: Real estate
real_estate.describe: buying, selling, renting or leasing property

fields.motivation: why they are moving or buying now
fields.existing_property_to_sell: true if they must sell or vacate first

loan.label: Loans / credit
loan.describe: personal, home, vehicle or business loan, credit card or other credit product

fields.product: personal loan, home loan, credit card, ...

other.label: Other
other.describe: anything that does not fit the types above
